{"code": "import numpy as np

# Since scipy is not available, use numpy to compute t-statistic manually
control_change = trial_clean[trial_clean['arm'] == 'control']['biomarker_change']
treatment_change = trial_clean[trial_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']['biomarker_change']

# Compute means and variances
mean_control = control_change.mean()
mean_treatment = treatment_change.mean()
var_control = control_change.var(ddof=1)  # unbiased variance
var_treatment = treatment_change.var(ddof=1)

n_control = len(control_change)
n_treatment = len(treatment_change)

# Welch's t-test (unequal variances)
se = np.sqrt(var_control / n_control + var_treatment / n_treatment)
t_stat = (mean_treatment - mean_control) / se

# Degrees of freedom (approximate)
df_numerator = (var_control / n_control + var_treatment / n_treatment)**2
df_denominator = (var_control / n_control)**2 / (n_control - 1) + (var_treatment / n_treatment)**2 / (n_treatment - 1)
df = df_numerator / df_denominator

# Two-tailed p-value
p_val = 2 * (1 - t.cdf(abs(t_stat), df))

print(f"Unadjusted t-test: t = {t_stat:.4f}, p = {p_val:.4f}")"}
